texts.content_exam: Hanan Al-Hroub was a poorly paid teacher in the West Bank. Then she won the $1 million Global Teacher Prize. The committee praised Mrs. Al-Hroub's 'play and learn' method. Besides her clown outfit, she uses balloons, hula-hoops, toy cars and puppets to explain her lessons. Her aim is to make the classroom a calm and fun place. 'We play first, and when we play we learn,' she said. Parents often refuse the focus on play at first. But that soon changes when they realise that her methods improve behaviour and academic results. She also sees it as her duty to build their characters. 'No to violence' is a motto in her classes.

questions.question: Hanan Al-Hroub was a ______ teacher before winning the prize.
She won the $1 million ______ .
Mrs. Al-Hroub uses ______ to explain her lessons.
options: balloons, hula-hoops, toy cars and puppets
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: balloons, hula-hoops, toy cars and puppets

questions.question: Her aim is to make the classroom a ______ place.
Mrs. Al-Hroub's method is called the ______ method.

texts.content_exam: Parents often refuse the focus on play at first. But that soon changes when they realise that her methods improve behaviour and academic results. She also sees it as her duty to build their characters. 'No to violence' is a motto in her classes. In addition to the toys, she uses videos and PowerPoint in the classroom. For the first month of a new school year, her eight-year-old pupils may not even see an exercise book. Mrs. Al-Hroub plans to establish her own foundation and use some of her winnings to train other teachers to follow her approach. It is worth mentioning that Mrs. Al-Hroub's dream was to be a doctor but failing to do so did not prevent her from being a special person who could make a difference.

questions.question: Mrs. Al-Hroub believes that children learn when they play.
Parents immediately support the focus on play.
'No to violence' is a motto in her classes.
What changes parents' minds about her method?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: improving behaviour and academic results

questions.question: What does Mrs. Al-Hroub plan to do with her winnings?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: establish a foundation and train other teachers

texts.content_exam: One day, an unemployed man went to apply for a job with Microsoft as a cleaner. The manager asked for his e-mail address to send him a form. The man said he had no computer or email address. The manager replied: 'That means you virtually don't exist and therefore can't be employed.' The man looked at his last £10 and thought of buying tomatoes in bulk. Within less than 2 hours, he sold all the tomatoes at 100% profit and ended up with almost £100 before going to sleep that night. Getting up early and going to bed late, he multiplied his profits quickly. After a short time, he bought a cart to transport boxes of tomatoes.

questions.question: The man applied for a job as a ______ at Microsoft.
The manager asked for his ______ address.
The man had no computer or ______ .
The manager said the man doesn't ______ and can't be employed.
The man was ______ before applying for the job.

texts.content_exam: Getting up early and going to bed late, he multiplied his profits quickly. After a short time, he bought a cart to transport boxes of tomatoes. By the end of the second year, he became the owner of a fleet of trucks and the manager of a staff of a hundred former unemployed people. Planning for the future of his family, he decided to buy life insurance. An adviser asked for his e-mail address. When the man replied that he has no e-mail, the adviser felt astonished. The man replied: 'I would be a floor cleaner at Microsoft!' This story teaches us that with determination, one can make a difference and we should never give up.

questions.question: After a short time, he bought a cart to transport tomatoes.
The adviser was astonished when the man said he had no email.
The man proved that success depends only on technology.
What did he buy after a short time?
What should we never do according to the story?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: We should never give up.
